title: Drop Day
premise: The crew runs a limited sneaker and merch drop at their shop: discounts, hype, sellouts and resale scams.

companion.name: KICKS
companion.about: a pigeon who lives in the shop window, wears a tiny bandana, very judgmental about prices

cast.RUBEN: hype; makes the signs and posts
cast.HYE-JIN: accountant; her calculator is always right
cast.SLY: a resale scammer; marks prices up, talks fast

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, graffiti teal, hot pink-red and gold palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.tasha: a girl age 11 with dark brown skin, a high bun with a pencil stuck in it and a paint-splattered denim jacket
fragments.ruben: a boy age 11 with tan skin, a curly black mop of hair, a bright orange hoodie and a megaphone
fragments.hyejin: a girl age 11 with light skin, a neat black bob, square glasses and a mint green sweater, holding a big calculator
fragments.cole: a boy age 11 with light skin, shaggy brown hair, a white t-shirt and very large chunky sneakers
fragments.kicks: a plump gray city pigeon wearing a tiny red bandana
fragments.sly: a lanky teenager age 16 with pale skin, slicked-back hair and a shiny tracksuit, carrying a suitcase of sneakers
fragments.shop: a small street sneaker shop with a wall of shoe shelves, graffiti art, a cash register and a big front window
